evidence.title: Agentastic overview
evidence.locator: Native macOS app; supported agents; isolation; review
evidence.finding: Describes SwiftUI and AppKit UI, parallel coding-agent CLIs, custom terminal tools, subscriptions, Git worktrees and Docker or Apple containers.

evidence.title: Agentastic release notes
evidence.finding: Documents Spaces task launching, manager issue pages, automatic continuation, token and estimated-cost display, artifact gallery, chat restoration and fixes.

evidence.title: Manager Agents
evidence.locator: Creating; issues; execution; remote hosts; Superfans
evidence.finding: Product-owned managers start and steer workers with dev, keep issues and wiki history, schedule runs and validate reports. Local managers require an open app; remote managers run on the host. No manager token or spend caps.

evidence.title: System dev CLI
evidence.finding: Documents Unix-socket JSON-RPC CLI for workspaces, worktrees, launch, status, tail, messages, manager objectives, artifacts and shared-space operations.

evidence.title: Cloud agents
evidence.locator: Providers; credentials; lifecycle and cost controls
evidence.finding: User supplies provider accounts and credentials; Agentastic provisions cloud sandboxes/VMs. Lifetimes and disconnect behavior vary by provider; persistent Hetzner/DigitalOcean VMs keep billing when powered off.

evidence.title: Remote machines
evidence.finding: SSH workers and terminals persist after Mac disconnect; user can manage remote repos, worktrees, agents and tunnels. Cross-host agent access is configurable.

evidence.title: Issue tracking
evidence.locator: Overview; linking; what the agent receives
evidence.finding: Linear and Sentry issues can be linked into prompts and worktrees; tracker plugins expose MCP search, read, comment and update.

evidence.title: Spaces
evidence.finding: Project overview shows attention, review-ready work, CI and 30-day activity history; board filters and labels organize tasks.

evidence.title: Artifacts
evidence.finding: Agents publish files; versions and searchable gallery persist, with comments and remote offline delivery.

evidence.title: Code review
evidence.locator: Supported agents; using review; multi-agent reviews
evidence.finding: Optional review invokes chosen reviewer CLIs in separate terminal tabs with captured diff and commit history; custom review commands are supported.

evidence.title: iPhone Companion
evidence.finding: Public TestFlight iPhone client pairs with a Mac using direct or relayed encrypted connections and supports agent monitoring and approvals.

evidence.title: License
evidence.finding: Agentastic.dev is proprietary and its source is not published. Open-source dependencies retain their own licenses.

evidence.title: Homebrew desktop cask
evidence.finding: Cask installs Agentastic.dev 0.19.0 from vendor DMG and requires macOS Sonoma.
